outline:
This course helps students to learn more about the core techniques of the ceramic fabrications. Based on the obtained knowledge shown in bellow, not only students will understand the more detailed principles but be able to design appropriate processes for most of ceramic products in the future.
	Synthesizing principles
	Dispersing techniques
	Slurry preparing and casting methods
	Sintering principles
schedule:
The course will cover the following topics:
	Introduction to ceramic fabrication processes
	Syntheses of ceramic materials
	Surface chemistries of ceramic powders
	Physical properties of ceramic powders
	Concept about colloidal system
	Dispersion principles of ceramic powders
	Dispersion processes for ceramics
	Dispersion characterization techniques
	Additives for ceramic processes
	Casting techniques of ceramic slurries
	Drying principles and processes
	Sintering theory and processes
